passage:
The drama club made posters for its school play. They spent hours drawing, coloring, and writing the time and place.
The next morning, one poster near the gate was missing. Club members were angry. They thought someone had taken it as a joke.
Later, the guard brought the poster to them. Strong wind had blown it down, and he had found it near the parking lot.
The club taped the posters more carefully after that. They also thanked the guard.
The missing poster reminded them that not every problem comes from bad people. Sometimes the wind is just wind. Looking for facts before blaming someone can save a lot of anger.
